name: schedule_update
description: Update an existing schedule. Only the fields you provide will be changed. Use run_mode to change how the schedule delivers its prompt: 'direct' sends to the parent session, 'delegate_new' creates a fresh sub-session each run, 'delegate_existing' routes to a specific existing session.

is_active.description: Set to true to enable or false to disable the schedule

name.description: New display name for the schedule

run_mode.description: 'direct' sends to the parent session. 'delegate_new' creates a fresh sub-session each run. 'delegate_existing' routes to a specific existing session.

prompt.description: New message or instruction (inner prompt for delegate modes)

delegate_session_id.description: New target session ID when run_mode is 'delegate_existing'

delegate_session_type.description: New sub-session type when run_mode is 'delegate_new'

action_type.description: Low-level: change action type. Prefer run_mode instead.

tool_name.description: Low-level: new tool name when action_type is 'tool'. Pass empty string to clear. Prefer run_mode instead.
